payout_quote: $400 Checking Bonus limited to new business customers who deposit at least $10,000 or more of new money into a business checking account at time of opening. Balance must be maintained for at least 60 days to qualify. ... $200 Checking Bonus limited to new business customers who deposit at least $5,000 or more of new money into a business checking account at opening.
biggest_catch: Offer limited to the first 50 qualifying customers — availability is capped; and if you close the account within 6 months the bank can claw back the bonus.
catches: Offer limited to the first 50 customers who meet the criteria — availability is capped.
Bank transfers from an existing personal or business First Federal Bank account do not qualify; must be new money.
Not valid for anyone whose accounts were closed within 90 days, or closed with a negative balance within the past three years.
One offer (up to $400) per business account; cannot be combined with any other offer.
Early closure clawback: if the account is closed within 6 months of opening, the bank reserves the right to deduct the bonus at closing.
Limited time offer; may be discontinued.
$50 minimum to open any new Business Checking account.
eCorp services may incur an additional service fee depending on business checking account type.
Bonus credited no later than 120 days from the open date; taxes apply.
eligibility: New First Federal Bank business customers in Florida (no existing First Federal accounts; no accounts closed in the past 90 days or with a negative balance in the past 3 years) who can deposit $5,000+ or $10,000+ in new money at account opening.
numeric_basis: payout from official First Federal Bank terms ($200/$400 flat); time: account opening with large new-money deposit, est. 45-90 min active
timing: Deposit new money at account opening; maintain balance for at least 60 days; bonus credited no later than 120 days from the open date; keep account open at least 6 months.
steps: Open a new First Federal Bank business checking account with $5,000+ ($200 bonus) or $10,000+ ($400 bonus) in new money at opening ($50 minimum to open).
Maintain the balance for at least 60 days.
Bonus is credited to the new account no later than 120 days from the open date.
Keep the account open at least 6 months to avoid the early-closure bonus deduction.
